summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness in the broad market, evidenced by massive premium accumulation in SPX 6000C and 7000C strikes for 2026. While SPX daily P/C is neutral (1.02), semiconductor names like MU, AMD, and NVDA show extreme bullish conviction with very low P/C ratios (0.23–0.31) and heavy BuyCall dominance. Persistent multi-day interest is concentrated in SPX 200C (exp 2026-07-17) with $6.4B in premium and SPX 6000C (exp 2026-06-18) with nearly $3B, signaling a massive, long-dated structural long bias. Traders should watch for continued upward momentum in the semiconductor sector and monitor if the heavy SPX 7600C/P hedging activity (exp 2026-09-18) leads to increased volatility near major psychological levels.
